name: Badge
summary: A small marker that counts or names a state, attached to something else. It comes in a solid fill and a soft tint, so a page can let what matters come forward and the rest recede.
summaryZh: 挂在别的东西上的小标记,用来计数或标状态。分实心和柔和两式:要紧的往前站,其余的退到后面。

variants.name: Soft primary
variants.note: A tint of the brand colour, with no outline.

parts.name: Dot
parts.note: A small dot in the badge's own foreground colour.

props.name: variant
props.description: Which state this badge carries. The base class on its own is the neutral badge.
props.descriptionZh: 这个徽标表示哪一种状态。只写基类就是中性徽标。

props.name: dot
props.description: Puts a dot in front of the label, in the badge's own foreground colour.
props.descriptionZh: 在文字前放一个圆点,颜色取徽标自己的前景色。

a11y.notes: The badge is text inside a plain <span>, so it is read where it sits and it is never focusable. When the count changes on its own, put the badge in a live region — role="status" — or the change is silent for anyone who cannot see it. A badge that only repeats what the label beside it already says can be marked aria-hidden instead.
a11y.notesZh: 徽标就是 <span> 里的一段文字,在哪儿就读到哪儿,也永远不进 Tab 顺序。计数自己变化时,要把徽标放进 live region(role="status"),不然看不见变化的人根本收不到通知;如果徽标只是重复旁边标签已经说过的话,直接 aria-hidden 就行。

examples.title: Variants
examples.description: The base class on its own is the neutral badge — a recessed fill in the mood's regular text colour. The five solid variants fill with the theme's own colour and take its matching on-colour, derived to reach 4.5:1.
examples.descriptionZh: 只写基类就是中性徽标:凹陷的底色,配 mood 的常规文字色。五种实心变体用主题自己的颜色填底,文字取对应的前景色,由主题派生保证 4.5:1。
examples.markup: Neutral 12 8 3 2 1

examples.title: Soft
examples.description: The soft badges tint toward the page, so they recede instead of competing. They carry no outline — the tag is the outlined member of this family.
examples.descriptionZh: 柔和徽标朝页面的方向淡化,所以是往后缩的,不是往前抢的。它们不带描边 —— 这个家族里描边的是标签。
examples.markup: 12 8 3 2 1

examples.title: Dot
examples.description: The dot takes the badge's own foreground colour, so it changes with the variant and needs no second colour.
examples.descriptionZh: 圆点取徽标自己的前景色,跟着变体走,不需要第二种颜色。

notes: The soft badge deliberately carries no border. A border one step off its own fill sits at 1.06:1 in brutal and 1.97:1 in the brightest mood, so it reads as a smear rather than an edge — and it would differ from theme to theme. The tag is the outlined member of the family; the badge is the filled one.
notesZh: 柔和徽标刻意不描边。跟自身底色只差一档的描边,在 brutal 里只有 1.06:1,在最亮的那套 mood 里也只有 1.97:1 —— 看上去是一道糊痕,不是一条边;而且每套 mood 还不一样。这个家族里描边的是标签,实心的是徽标。
